title: It's too small.
description: A lady goes shopping for a dress. The assistant shows her several dresses, but they are all too small. The lesson covers comparative and superlative forms of adjectives (small-smaller-smallest, pretty-prettier-prettiest).
answer_note: Practice A (comprehension) and Practice B (write and spell) answers are from the workbook answer key. Grammar answers are from the grammar practice book key.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: Do you like this dress, madam?
lines.translation: 夫人，您喜欢这件衣服吗？

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.text: I like the colour very much. It's a lovely dress, but it's too small for me.
lines.translation: 我很喜欢这颜色。这是件漂亮的衣服，可是对我来说太小了。

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: What about this one? It's a lovely dress. It's very smart. Short skirts are in fashion now. Would you like to try it?
lines.translation: 这件怎么样？这是件漂亮的衣服，它很时髦。短裙现在正流行。您要试一试吗？

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.text: I'm afraid this green dress is too small for me as well. It's smaller than the blue one.
lines.translation: 恐怕这件绿色的我穿着也太小了。它比那件蓝色的还要小。

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.text: I don't like the colour either. It doesn't suit me at all. I think the blue dress is prettier.
lines.translation: 我也不喜欢这种颜色。这颜色我穿着根本不合适。我认为那件蓝色的更漂亮些。

lines.speaker: Lady
lines.text: Could you show me another blue dress? I want a dress like that one, but it must be my size.
lines.translation: 您能再给我看一件蓝色的吗？我想要一件和那件一样的，但必须是我的尺寸。

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: I'm afraid I haven't got a larger dress. This is the largest dress in the shop.
lines.translation: 恐怕没有更大的了。这是店里最大的一件。

items.meaning: 夫人，女士（对妇女的尊称）

items.title: madam
items.text: madam，是对妇女的一种尊称，服务行业的人员常用此称呼；同时，对于不知姓名的女士也可以用此来表示尊重。这个单词也可拼作ma'am /mæm/。

items.title: Would you like ...?
items.text: Would you like ...? 你愿意……吗？用来表示委婉的请求或提议。

items.title: It's smaller than the blue one.
items.text: 它比那套蓝色的小一些。在英文中，当我们把一个人或物与另一个人或物进行比较时，就要用形容词的比较级。大多数单音节的形容词的比较级是在原级后面加上er，如small-smaller，large-larger；有些以y结尾的双音节形容词，如果y前面是一个辅音字母，变比较级时就要把y先变为i，然后再加er，如pretty-prettier。如果在句子中提到了对比的双方，就必须在比较级后面加上than，如It's smaller than the blue one。如果形容词比较级所指很清楚，比较级也可以独立存在，如I haven't got a larger dress.

items.title: Could you ...?
items.text: 用在表示请求，比Can you ...?更婉转客气。例：Could you tell me the way to the post office? 请你告诉我去邮局怎么走好吗？

items.title: This is the largest dress in the shop.
items.text: 这是店里最大的一件衣服。句中使用了形容词的最高级，它是在形容词原级后面加上est，在最高级形容词之前要加定冠词the。最高级用在将一个人或物与其他一个以上的人或物作比较时。

practice.title: Practice A: Comprehension
practice.instruction: Look at the dialogue on Students' Book page 217 and answer these questions.
practice.translation: 参见学生用书第217页上的对话，然后回答以下问题。
practice.answer_note: Model answers based on the dialogue.
practice.context: Answer each comprehension question about the dialogue.

questions.prompt: Does the lady like the colour of the first dress?
questions.answer: Yes, she does.

questions.prompt: Does she think it's a lovely dress?
questions.answer: Yes, she does.

questions.prompt: Is it too big for her?
questions.answer: No, it's too small for her.

questions.prompt: The assistant shows her another dress. Has she got a long skirt?
questions.answer: No, she's got a short skirt.

questions.prompt: What does the assistant say about short skirts?
questions.answer: She says short skirts are in fashion now.

questions.prompt: Is the green dress too small for her?
questions.answer: Yes, it is.

questions.prompt: Is it smaller or bigger than the blue dress?
questions.answer: It's smaller than the blue dress.

questions.prompt: Does the green dress suit her?
questions.answer: No, it doesn't suit her at all.

questions.prompt: Which is prettier, the blue dress or the green one? What does she think?
questions.answer: The blue dress is prettier. She thinks the blue dress is prettier.

questions.prompt: What does the lady ask the assistant beginning 'Could you ...?'
questions.answer: She asks, 'Could you show me another blue dress?'

questions.prompt: Has the assistant got a larger dress?
questions.answer: No, he hasn't.

questions.prompt: She is holding a dress. How does she describe it? What does she say?
questions.answer: She says, 'This is the largest dress in the shop.'

practice.title: Practice B: Write and spell
practice.instruction: Write your address in full (in English) and, as you write it, spell it out loud. Write the name of your school or college (in English) and, as you write it, spell it out loud.
practice.translation: 用英语写出你的地址，并大声拼读。用英语写出你学校的名字，并大声拼读。
practice.answer_note: Open-ended personal exercises. Model answers provided.
practice.context: Write your address and school name in English, spelling each word.

questions.prompt: Write your address in full (in English) and, as you write it, spell it out loud.
questions.answer: [Personal answer - e.g., 123 Main Street, Springfield. O-N-E, T-W-O, T-H-R-E-E, M-A-I-N, S-T-R-E-E-T, S-P-R-I-N-G-F-I-E-L-D]

questions.prompt: Write the name of your school or college (in English) and, as you write it, spell it out loud.
questions.answer: [Personal answer - e.g., Springfield High School. S-P-R-I-N-G-F-I-E-L-D, H-I-G-H, S-C-H-O-O-L]

grammar.title: Grammar I: Write the comparative and superlative forms
grammar.instruction: Write the comparative and superlative forms of the adjectives.
grammar.translation: 写出下列形容词的比较级和最高级形式。
grammar.key_source: pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf (Lesson 107 I, PDF p.537-538)
grammar.context: Write the comparative and superlative forms of each adjective.

questions.prompt: hot
questions.answer: hotter, hottest

questions.prompt: heavy
questions.answer: heavier, heaviest

questions.prompt: large
questions.answer: larger, largest

questions.prompt: big
questions.answer: bigger, biggest

questions.prompt: thin
questions.answer: thinner, thinnest

questions.prompt: new
questions.answer: newer, newest

questions.prompt: nice
questions.answer: nicer, nicest

questions.prompt: easy
questions.answer: easier, easiest

questions.prompt: lazy
questions.answer: lazier, laziest

questions.prompt: tall
questions.answer: taller, tallest

grammar.title: Grammar II: Comment on each statement
grammar.instruction: Comment on each statement according to the examples. Example: His sister is thin but he is very thin. → Yes, he's thinner than his sister.
grammar.translation: 仿照例句写出下列各句的对应句。例句：他妹妹很瘦但他非常瘦。→ 是的，他比他妹妹瘦。
grammar.key_source: pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf (Lesson 107 II, PDF p.538)
grammar.context: Comment on each statement using the comparative form. Items 1 and 2 are printed examples.

questions.prompt: His sister is thin but he is very thin.
questions.answer: Yes, he's thinner than his sister.

questions.prompt: This table is big but that table is very big.
questions.answer: Yes, that table is bigger than this one.

questions.prompt: His wife is fat but he is very fat.
questions.answer: Yes, he is fatter than his wife.

questions.prompt: Her sister is pretty but she is very pretty.
questions.answer: Yes, she is prettier than her sister.

questions.prompt: That question is easy but this question is very easy.
questions.answer: Yes, this question is easier than that one.

questions.prompt: These baskets are full but those baskets are very full.
questions.answer: Yes, those baskets are fuller than these.

questions.prompt: That picture is nice but this picture is very nice.
questions.answer: Yes, this picture is nicer than that one.

questions.prompt: That road is wide but this road is very wide.
questions.answer: Yes, this road is wider than that one.

questions.prompt: Her dress is smart but her sister's dress is very smart.
questions.answer: Yes, her sister's dress is smarter than hers.

questions.prompt: Those apples are big but these apples are very big.
questions.answer: Yes, these apples are bigger than those.

questions.prompt: These people are lazy but those people are very lazy.
questions.answer: Yes, those people are lazier than these.

questions.prompt: It was hot yesterday but it's very hot today.
questions.answer: Yes, it's hotter today than it was yesterday.

questions.prompt: The days in autumn are short but the days in winter are very short.
questions.answer: Yes, the days in winter are shorter than the days in autumn.

questions.prompt: These knives are sharp but those knives are very sharp.
questions.answer: Yes, those knives are sharper than these.

grammar.title: Grammar III: Answer the questions
grammar.instruction: Answer the questions according to the example. Example: All the chairs are low, aren't they? → Yes, but this one is the lowest. It's the lowest of all the chairs.
grammar.translation: 仿照例句回答下列问题。例句：所有的椅子都很矮，不是吗？→ 是的，但这把椅子最矮。它是所有椅子中最矮的。
grammar.key_source: pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf (Lesson 107 III, PDF p.538)
grammar.context: Answer each question using the superlative form. Item 1 is a printed example.

questions.prompt: All the chairs are low, aren't they?
questions.answer: Yes, but this one is the lowest. It's the lowest of all the chairs.

questions.prompt: All the questions are easy, aren't they?
questions.answer: Yes, but this one is the easiest. It's the easiest of all the questions.

questions.prompt: All the books are new, aren't they?
questions.answer: Yes, but this one is the newest. It's the newest of all the books.

questions.prompt: All the pencils are short, aren't they?
questions.answer: Yes, but this one is the shortest. It's the shortest of all the pencils.

questions.prompt: All the pictures are nice, aren't they?
questions.answer: Yes, but this one is the nicest. It's the nicest of all the pictures.

questions.prompt: All the policemen are strong, aren't they?
questions.answer: Yes, but this one is the strongest. He's the strongest of all the policemen.

questions.prompt: All the oranges are sweet, aren't they?
questions.answer: Yes, but this one is the sweetest. It's the sweetest of all the oranges.

questions.prompt: All the children are clever, aren't they?
questions.answer: Yes, but this one is the cleverest. She/He's the cleverest of all the children.
